in_sanskrit.name: Ashkit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Horse or Warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashkit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ash means 'horse' in Sanskrit, and kit means 'warrior' or 'rider'. This name is derived from the Ashvins, the divine twin horse-deities in Hindu mythology.

in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Horse or Warrior

in_tamil.name: Ashkit
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Horse or Warrior
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ashkit ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Ash means 'horse' in Sanskrit, and kit means 'warrior' or 'rider'. This name is derived from the Ashvins, the divine twin horse-deities in Hindu mythology.

in_telugu.name: Ashkit
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Horse or Warrior
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ashkit ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Ash means 'horse' in Sanskrit, and kit means 'warrior' or 'rider'. This name is derived from the Ashvins, the divine twin horse-deities in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Ashkit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Horse or Warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashkit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ash means 'horse' in Sanskrit, and kit means 'warrior' or 'rider'. This name is derived from the Ashvins, the divine twin horse-deities in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Horse or Warrior
